Hi all —

Thanks for the interest in a shared office hours/demo for Redwood Inference. We're running a 60-minute session next week to demo our serving runtime, routing/fallback controls, and a short Q&A. We want this to be practical for engineering teams — short live demo, then 20 minutes split into two breakout tracks (Platform/Infra and Product/Use-cases).

Proposed slots (pick one that fits for your team):
- Tue Apr 13, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (Americas/EMEA overlap)
- Thu Apr 15, 7:30 PM PT / Fri Apr 16, 10:30 AM AET (APAC-friendly slot)

Agenda (draft):
- 10m — Quick intros & objectives
- 20m — Live demo: latency/cost controls, batching, routing policies
- 20m — Breakouts: (A) Platform: deployment/Private/VPC questions; (B) Product: prompt strategies & evals
- 10m — Q&A + next steps

Attached: short agenda and I’ll send calendar invites once we lock a slot. If you prefer a dedicated walkthrough for your infra team instead of the breakout, let me know and we can spin up a separate session.

If anyone on your side has a hard constraint, flag it and we’ll try to accommodate.

Cheers,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai/team/rishi
